result.reason: The clause does not reach either playbook position because it includes no cap on price increases. It also does not provide the preferred 60-day renewal reminder. Although Customer receives a 30-day termination right after the Initial Term, this is not clearly drafted as a right to opt out before renewal and may require Customer to enter the first renewal term before giving notice. The edit also unnecessarily changes Kubient’s termination right by making termination effective only at the end of the then-current Term, contrary to the comment that its notice right is unchanged. That alteration affects unrelated commercial intent.
